cognitive_contract.label: Retrieve / master theorems (National/International Olympiad)
cognitive_contract.decisive_act: Direct extraction and disambiguation of international Olympiad master theorems, universal identities, and invariant configurations to evaluate protected claim W.
cognitive_contract.band_protected_work: Require learner to distinguish subtle structural duals and orientations without intermediate taxonomic scaffolding.
cognitive_contract.support_posture: Activate the underlying geometric or algebraic context without stating the master theorem formulation.

slots.X: retrieving the exact geometric tangency relations established by Feuerbach's Theorem
slots.Y: arbitrary triangle with incircle, three excircles, and nine-point circle
slots.Z: Feuerbach invariant: the nine-point circle is tangent internally to the incircle and tangent externally to all three excircles
slots.W: The nine-point circle is tangent internally to the incircle and tangent externally to all three excircles
slots.wrong_idea: inverting the orientations, claiming the nine-point circle is tangent externally to the incircle and internally to the excircles
slots.replacement_rule: the incircle lies entirely inside the nine-point circle (internal tangency), while the three excircles lie outside (external tangency)
slots.visual_job: render Euler nine-point circle showing internal tangency point with incircle and three external tangency points with excircles; avoid unmounted SVGs
slots.check_job: independent verification: distance from nine-point center N to incenter I is R/2 - r (internal tangency); distance to excenter I_a is R/2 + r_a (external tangency). Verified.

core2_custody.stem_requirement: Exact formulation of an international Olympiad master theorem retrieval demand
core2_custody.hint_ladder_requirement: H1 activates foundational distance/modular context; H2 provides intermediate structural formulation; preserves W
core2_custody.solution_requirement: Locked pre-commit; complete formal statement with distance-based proof outline
core2_custody.distractor_requirement: Every distractor explained with specific student conceptual confusion or orientation inversion

core1a_declarative.anti_leak_rule: Strict prohibition on leaking Core 2 exact parameters or textual answer in Core 1A text

core1b_reconstruction.model_alternation: Reconstruction must use an alternative analytical pathway (e.g. barycentric coordinates or inversion)

core2a_supported_practice.transfer_obligation: Near-transfer item retrieving companion master theorem properties

core2b_transfer_assessment.transfer_obligation: Far-transfer item applying the retrieved master theorem to an Olympiad configuration
